author: cellish
body:
Umm, a thing that we should bring back to the Avicus Network is that before, kill streaks was shown... maybe we could bring it back and of course so everyone can see your killstreaks...

Just not like it was before: "You have reached a 10 kill killstreak"
Ok, maybe it wasn't just exactly like that... But yea, u understand...

As it stays in public like this: "(that person) has reached a 5 player killstreak"

And as it stays in different colors by how high the killstreak is :D

Hope you like this idea :D <3
